title: The Telangana Prohibition of Smoking and Health Protection Act, 2002.
full_text: The Telangana Prohibition of Smoking and Health Protection Act, 2002. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200214 Act Number: 14 Enactment Date: 2002-05-02 Act Year: 2002 Short Title: The Telangana Prohibition of Smoking and Health Protection Act, 2002. Long Title: An Act to provide for Prohibition of smoking in places of public work or public use and in public service vehicles in the State of Telangana and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of Health, Medical and Family Welfare Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Declaration of non-smoking places. Section 4. Appointment of authorised officers. Section 5. Prohibition of smoking in places of public work or use. Section 6. Prohibition of smoking in public service vehicles. Section 7. Prohibition on advertisement of cigarettes etc. Section 8. Prohibition of sale of cigarettes, etc., to minors. Section 9. Prohibition of storage, sale and distribution of cigarettes etc. in the vicinity of educational Institutions. Section 10.
